AI visibility is how often AI assistants name your brand when someone asks them for a recommendation. Only a handful of brands make the list in any given answer. Those brands have AI v isibility. The rest go unseen by the person who asked. Some people call it AI brand visibility or AI search visibility. Either way the question is the same: when AI answers, do you get named or not? This is not the same as your Google ranking. A site can lead in search and still never get mentioned by an assistant, because the model picks what to say from a different set of signals.
